title: Sr. Design Engineer Automation
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Prepare **electrical control panel designs, control circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, and electrical schematics**.
* Develop and review automation architecture based on machine requirements.
* Select appropriate **PLC, HMI, VFD, servo drives, sensors, relays, switches, motors, safety devices, and other automation components**.
* Prepare **Bill of Materials (BOM)** and technical specifications for automation\-related components.
* Develop and modify **PLC/HMI programs** and coordinate with automation programmers for machine commissioning.
* Integrate PLC, HMI, VFD, servo systems, sensors, actuators, pneumatic systems, and other automation equipment.
* Support development and implementation of **machine sequence logic, interlocks, alarms, and safety functions**.
* Review machine functionality and identify opportunities for improving automation, productivity, reliability, and cycle time.
* Coordinate with **Mechanical Design, Production, Electrical, Purchase, Quality, and Service teams** for successful project execution.
* Review automation requirements, customer specifications, and project drawings.
* Participate in **FAT, SAT, machine testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting** activities.
* Identify and resolve automation\-related issues during machine assembly, testing, installation, and commissioning.
* Provide technical support to production, service, and maintenance teams whenever required.
* Maintain proper documentation of electrical drawings, PLC programs, HMI programs, BOMs, manuals, and project\-related technical documents.
* Ensure automation designs comply with applicable **industrial safety standards and company quality requirements**.
* Evaluate new automation technologies and recommend suitable solutions for improving machine performance.
* Guide and support junior design/automation engineers and technicians.
* Ensure assigned projects are completed within defined **quality, cost, and delivery timelines**.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong knowledge of **Industrial Automation and Control Systems**.
* Good understanding of **PLC, HMI, VFD, Servo Drives, Sensors, Actuators, and Industrial Communication**.
* Knowledge of PLC programming and troubleshooting.
* Experience in electrical/control panel design and electrical schematics.
* Knowledge of **AutoCAD Electrical / EPLAN or equivalent electrical design software**.
* Understanding of **pneumatics and electro\-pneumatic systems**.
* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as **Ethernet/IP, Modbus, Profibus/Profinet**, etc.
* Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings and machine layouts.
* Good knowledge of machine safety, interlocking, emergency circuits, and safety devices.
* Ability to troubleshoot automation systems independently.

Educational Qualification

* **B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.**

Experience

* **4–8 years of relevant experience** in industrial automation, machine automation, special\-purpose machines, or manufacturing equipment.
* Experience in **machine building / OEM / automation projects** will be preferred.

title: Cloud and DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**The Role: Cloud \& DevSecOps Engineer**

Day to day, that means designing and running our infrastructure across Google Cloud Platform and AWS, owning our GitLab CI/CD pipelines, and implementing the security controls that protect PHI and financial data.

This role has a deliberate growth path. You will start as the hands\-on engineer who builds and secures the platform. Over your first year, you will work alongside the team lead and an external compliance specialist. During that time you will take on increasing ownership of our HIPAA program and SOC 2 Type II attestation, moving from implementing controls to designing and leading them. The goal is that you become our security and compliance lead. We will fund necessary training to get you there.

If you want your infrastructure and security decisions to actually matter, and you want a path from senior engineer to program owner, this is that role.

**What You'll Do**

***Cloud Architecture: GCP and AWS***

* Design, deploy, and operate our SaaS infrastructure across GCP and AWS using HIPAA\-aligned reference architectures.
* Make sure every workload touching PHI runs only on HIPAA\-eligible services. Business Associate Agreements must be signed for each cloud account and project before any PHI lands.
* Implement network segmentation and VPC design, encryption at rest and in transit, KMS key management, and least\-privilege IAM across both clouds.
* Build everything as infrastructure\-as\-code with Terraform. Environments should be reproducible, reviewable, and auditable.

***DevOps and GitLab CI/CD***

* Own and improve our GitLab CI/CD pipelines end to end: build, test, scan, deploy.
* Integrate security scanning into the pipeline (SAST, dependency and SCA scanning, container and IaC scanning) without turning delivery into a crawl.
* Manage secrets, artifacts, and release processes securely. Keep PHI out of logs, caches, and lower environments.
* Support the development team. Good pipelines make other engineers faster, not slower.

***Security Engineering***

* Implement and maintain technical safeguards: phishing\-resistant MFA, centralized audit logging, monitoring and alerting, vulnerability management, and incident response.
* Enforce bastion or VDI\-only production access with no local download of PHI, backed by DLP and egress controls.
* Keep production access minimal and regularly reviewed. Use de\-identified or synthetic data in development and test environments.
* Respond to security events and lead post\-incident reviews.

***Compliance: HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, Plaid***

*Starting out, you implement and evidence. Over time, you design and lead.*

* Implement the technical controls behind our HIPAA Security Rule safeguards and SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, then take ownership of the program as you grow into the role.
* Operate our compliance automation platform (Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe): keep evidence collection running, monitor for control drift, close gaps.
* Own the security side of our Plaid integration. That means TLS 1\.2\+ and mTLS where required, encrypted secrets, least\-privilege access to financial data, and monitoring for unauthorized access. You will also support Plaid's production access review and security questionnaire. Handling consumer financial data carries GLBA and FTC Safeguards Rule obligations, and you will help us meet them.
* Support penetration tests and audits: help scope them, coordinate with the testers and auditor, and drive remediation.
* Over time, you will lead the HIPAA risk analysis, own control design, select and manage the external auditor, and carry us through the SOC 2 Type II observation period.

**What You Need**

* 3\+ years in cloud engineering, DevOps, or DevSecOps.
* Hands\-on production experience on both GCP and AWS. Not one cloud plus a certification in the other: real production work in both.
* Strong GitLab CI/CD experience, or equivalent CI/CD depth and the ability to move to GitLab quickly.
* Terraform and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Practical security engineering: IAM and least privilege, encryption, secrets management, network security, logging and monitoring.
* Working exposure to HIPAA or SOC 2 in practice. You should be able to explain what a control is and how you'd evidence it.
* The judgment to handle PHI responsibly and work inside strict access controls.
* Clear written and spoken English. You will document data flows, controls, and decisions that auditors and customers read.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior work at a healthcare, fintech, or other regulated SaaS company handling sensitive data.
* Hands\-on experience with a compliance automation platform (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, Sprinto).
* Experience integrating a financial data provider such as Plaid, and awareness of GLBA / FTC Safeguards Rule obligations.
* Any of these certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Architect, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CCSP, CISM, HITRUST CCSFP.
* Experience working directly with external auditors or remediating penetration test findings.

**How To Apply:** Share your CV on careers@dronatechlabs.com

Pay: ₹80,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

title: AI Solutions Architect / Lead Developer
description:
**Experience:** 4\-8 Years
**Vacancy:** 1
**Type:** Full Time
**Job Location:** Gandhinagar


We are seeking a highly skilled AI Solutions Architect / Lead Developer who can both architect and build enterprise\-grade AI solutions. This is a hands\-on role requiring deep technical expertise in Generative AI, Microsoft AI technologies, application development, automation, and data analytics.


The ideal candidate will have experience designing and implementing AI\-powered applications, intelligent agents, workflow automation solutions, and business productivity tools leveraging Azure OpenAI, Copilot technologies, and Microsoft Power Platform. The candidate should be capable of independently taking solutions from concept to deployment.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


**AI Solution Architecture \& Development**


* Design, develop, and deploy enterprise AI solutions using Azure OpenAI and OpenAI APIs.
* Architect and implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
* Build AI agents and multi\-agent workflows for business use cases.
* Develop prompt engineering frameworks and reusable AI components.
* Design secure, scalable, and production\-ready AI applications.
* Integrate LLMs with enterprise data sources and business applications.
* Implement monitoring, evaluation, and optimization strategies for AI solutions.


**Microsoft AI \& Copilot Ecosystem**


* Build custom solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Develop Copilot extensions, plugins, and custom actions.
* Leverage Azure AI Foundry for AI application development and deployment.
* Integrate AI solutions with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and Dynamics environments.
* Utilize Microsoft Graph APIs to connect enterprise systems and data.


**Application Development**


* Develop backend services using Python.
* Design and consume REST APIs.
* Build AI\-powered web applications and automation tools.
* Develop integrations using JSON\-based APIs and cloud services.
* Create lightweight front\-end interfaces using JavaScript where required.


**Automation \& Productivity Solutions**


* Develop Excel\-based AI tools and add\-ins.
* Automate business workflows using Power Automate.
* Build low\-code applications using Power Apps.
* Create Office Scripts and Excel automation solutions.
* Design end\-to\-end automation workflows for finance, operations, and compliance functions.


**Data Engineering \& Analytics**


* Build data processing pipelines using Python and Pandas.
* Design and maintain data models and database schemas.
* Develop dashboards and insights using Power BI.
* Perform structured and unstructured data analysis.
* Optimize solutions for performance, scalability, and usability.

**Required Technical Skills****:**
----------------------------------


**AI \& Generative AI**


Must have hands\-on experience with:


* Azure OpenAI Services, OpenAI APIs, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Prompt Engineering, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agent Development, LLM Application Development, Vector Databases and Semantic Search, AI Governance and Responsible AI practices


**Programming \& Development**


* Advanced Python development, SQL and database querying, REST API development and integration, JSON data structures and API payload design, JavaScript (Basic to Intermediate), Git Version Control, Object\-Oriented Programming principles


**Microsoft Ecosystem**


* Excel Automation, Office Scripts, Power Automate, Power Apps, Microsoft Graph API, Microsoft 365 Integrations, Copilot Extensibility, SharePoint Online Integrations


**Data \& Analytics**


* Pandas, Power BI, Data Modelling, Database Design, Data Transformation, Business Intelligence Reporting

**Required Experience****:**
----------------------------


* 4\-8 years of software development, automation, or solution architecture experience.
* Minimum 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in Generative AI solution development.
* Experience deploying AI solutions in Azure environments.
* Experience integrating enterprise systems using APIs.
* Proven experience developing automation and productivity solutions within the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Experience working with structured and unstructured business data.

**Preferred Experience****:**
-----------------------------


Experience building solutions such as:


* Excel add\-ins integrated with Azure OpenAI
* AI\-powered financial analysis tools
* Valuation modelling assistants built using Python and LLMs
* Financial statement extraction and processing tools
* Automated report review and summarization agents
* Contract review and compliance agents
* Knowledge management and enterprise search solutions
* Copilot\-based business productivity assistants
* Workflow automation solutions powered by AI agents

**Soft Skills****:**
--------------------


* Strong solution architecture mindset
* Ability to translate business problems into AI\-powered solutions
* Excellent stakeholder communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities
* Self\-driven and capable of independently delivering projects
* Ability to mentor junior developers and lead technical discussions

**Success Criteria****:**
-------------------------


The successful candidate should be able to:


* Independently design and build production\-ready AI solutions.
* Develop and deploy RAG\-based applications and AI agents.
* Create Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, and Azure AI solutions.
* Deliver end\-to\-end solutions from architecture through deployment.
* Build practical business applications that generate measurable productivity and efficiency gains.


**Ideal Profile:** A hands\-on AI engineer who combines the capabilities of a Solution Architect, AI Developer, Automation Specialist, and Microsoft Platform Expert, with the ability to build real\-world business solutions rather than only designing them.
